_README: What you actually saw at a site. The strongest evidence this project holds:
everything else is a guess, a lookup, or an inference.
Each observation is tied to a siteId + waterbodyId so it is never applied to
`feed` is the most important field. A hydrocyclone separating deliberately
disturbed bed sediment is close to the easiest duty it will ever be given -
that feed is far coarser and more concentrated than the water normally runs.
It proves the unit separates and does not block. It says little about the
fine fraction that governs membrane loading. Be honest here.
natural       - the water as it normally runs
disturbed-bed - bed kicked up, dredged or agitated
spiked        - dosed with a known material
`doesNotShow` is not optional. Filling it in is what stops a good result
being over-read later, by you or by an agent.

observations.observation: Riverbed sediment was deliberately disturbed upstream and the water processed through the system. Physical separation was confirmed in both the 10 mm and the 5 mm hydrocyclone; solids reported to the underflow in both units.
shows: Both units physically separate solids on water from this site.
Both passed a coarse, concentrated feed without blocking or bridging - a real operability result, and often where small-diameter cyclones fail.
The bed material at this reach contains a coarse fraction these units remove.
doesNotShow: A cut size. Seeing separation does not tell you the size at which half the mass reports to the underflow.
A separation efficiency, or what fraction of the feed solids was removed.
Behaviour on the naturally suspended load, which is finer than disturbed bed material and is what governs membrane loading.
Any benefit to a downstream membrane - no membrane was run against a control.
